title: EHAL Device Role Template (2.4.g / 2.7.n-5)
description: Groups M1 EHAL fields by device role for adapter mapping aids. Does not extend the Live wire contract. Units/signs follow docs/spec/ehal.md. Optional loxone / openems blocks hold hub ↔ EHAL conversion (factor/sign = hub → EHAL; write applies inverse). Stub roles (consumer, heatpump) may list future/flex fields with kind=stub.

status.description: m1 = maps Live EHAL fields; stub = forward-looking (no first-class M1 wire fields yet).

field.description: M1 EHAL field name, or stub identifier (e.g. flex.enable_name) when kind=stub.

required.description: Mapping completeness (M1 HITL); independent of loxone.read_required.

loxone.description: Loxone hub ↔ EHAL conversion. factor/sign always mean hub → EHAL; write applies inverse after EHAL clamps. omit_if / read_required apply on read only.

unit.description: Unit on the Loxone wire (e.g. kW, %).

factor.description: Hub → EHAL: multiply hub value by this after sign. Write divides by (sign * factor).

sign.description: Multiplicative sign (±1) applied before factor (hub → EHAL).

clamp_min.description: Inclusive lower clamp in EHAL space; null = none.

clamp_max.description: Inclusive upper clamp in EHAL space; null = none.

omit_if.description: Read only: if 'negative', omit when raw (pre-factor) hub value is < 0. Ignored on write.

read_required.description: Read only: if true, missing/bad Loxone read aborts plant telemetry. Ignored on write.

openems.description: OpenEMS ↔ EHAL polarity/clamp (typically W↔W). factor/sign = hub → EHAL; write applies inverse after EHAL clamps.

unit.description: Unit on the OpenEMS channel (default W).

factor.description: Hub → EHAL scale (usually 1 for OpenEMS watts).

clamp_min.description: Inclusive lower clamp in EHAL space; null = none.

clamp_max.description: Inclusive upper clamp in EHAL space; null = none.

unit_sign_notes.description: Pointer to frozen EHAL conventions; do not redefine math.
